paragraphs.part: Part One: The Profession of Faith
paragraphs.section: Section Two: The Profession of the Christian Faith
paragraphs.summary: Mary, kept free from original sin, was taken up body and soul into heavenly glory when her earthly life ended. Her Assumption is a unique share in her Son's Resurrection and a sign of the resurrection promised to all Christians.

paragraphs.part: Part One: The Profession of Faith
paragraphs.section: Section Two: The Profession of the Christian Faith
paragraphs.summary: Honoring Mary belongs to Christian worship, but it differs in kind from the adoration given to God alone. Marian feasts and prayers such as the Rosary, which sums up the whole Gospel, express this devotion.

paragraphs.section: Section One: Prayer in the Christian Life
paragraphs.summary: In the medieval West the Rosary grew up as a popular form of prayer for people who could not pray the Liturgy of the Hours.
